an OwnerId, ReservationId or JoinConflictId that occurred anywhere in that closure is never fresh again even when its holder/group is retired

OwnershipState.law: when join_conflicts is nonempty, every MaybeMoved place in this state references that one JoinConflictId and no ordinary Live place embeds predecessor-alternative owner or token identity

conditional_laws: MaybeMoved requires join_conflict_id_or_null to resolve exactly once and owner/token/reservation fields to be null
non-MaybeMoved states require join_conflict_id_or_null to be null
Moved and Uninitialized have no owner and no available cleanup token

a Live Affine or Resource ownership-unit place has exactly one OwnerId and is its unique state-local holder; every projection has owner_id_or_null null and resolves ownership through ownership_unit_move_path_id_or_null
a Live Reusable or nonowning-view place has owner_id_or_null null
DropExactlyOnce requires exactly one available token at the ownership-unit place, owned by that OwnerId; its projections have null token
None and ViewRelease require cleanup_token_id_or_null null; ViewRelease is discharged only by the matching LoanDef end transition
an Unbound or Consumed cleanup token has holder_owner_id_or_null null
reservation_id_or_null is non-null iff one matching Active MoveReservationState names this exact place

fields.mismatching_places: canonical-sorted nonempty array<PlaceId> whose exact predecessor tuples differ
fields.covered_places: canonical-sorted nonempty rows keyed by PlaceId; includes every declared PlaceId whose owner-normalized place overlaps any mismatching place after ViewAliasBinding normalization, and each row contains every predecessor OwnershipStateId and its exact initialization, owner_id_or_null, reservation_id_or_null, cleanup_token_id_or_null and prior JoinConflictId

laws: one n-ary Join operation creates at most one JoinConflictId and every covered place becomes MaybeMoved with null owner/token/reservation and references it
predecessor alternatives are mutually exclusive; OwnerId and CleanupTokenId uniqueness is checked independently inside each predecessor state slice, not across alternatives
no Live place remains whose normalized owner place overlaps a mismatching place; a proven-disjoint sibling remains outside coverage
a JoinConflict is diagnostic-only and admits no read, write, move, borrow, cleanup, suspension, escape or serialization residue

LoanState.presence_rule: absence is allowed only when the LoanDef start point is not in the typed reachable prefix of this state point
laws: Active or Suspended requires every PlaceState in the LoanDef view_alias_bindings view subtree Live; Ended or not-yet-started absence requires that entire view subtree Uninitialized

R5 admits at most one non-Ended direct child per non-Ended parent; a parent is Suspended iff that child is Active or Suspended, an Active loan has no non-Ended child, and therefore each live reborrow chain has exactly one Active leaf. Ending the Active leaf returns only its immediate parent to Active while higher ancestors remain Suspended.
a status/view/parent-child mismatch is INPUT_INVALID before semantic evaluation
Unbound is a fresh predeclared token epoch not yet attached to an owner
Available has exactly one holder OwnerId
Consumed has null holder and never becomes Unbound or Available again
every reachable OwnershipState contains exactly one CleanupTokenState row for every CleanupTokenDef; omission or duplication is INPUT_INVALID
ReservationId is unique across the typed reachable prefix and is supplied explicitly by ReserveMove
only the exact active ReservationId may be consumed by Move or cancelled by CancelReservation
Consumed and Cancelled reservations never become Active again

OwnerDef.law: origin_place_id and origin_region_id are immutable provenance; at a queried state the derived binding is exactly one of Unissued, one unique Live ownership-unit PlaceState holder, one state-level conditional JoinConflict alternative group, or Retired. The monotone automaton is Unissued -> Live exactly once; Live -> Live is admitted only as one atomic holder transfer; Live -> Retired; Retired is terminal; an issued identity never returns to Unissued. Current region exists only for a unique Live holder and is that holder PlaceDef.storage_region_id.

RegionDef.law: parent relation is acyclic and containment is proven through this tree plus CFG reachability

laws: owner_place_id is the borrowed storage; view_place_id is a distinct nonowning PlaceDef whose RCTS projection is borrow/ViewRelease for Shared or inout/ViewRelease for Exclusive
view_descriptor_type_id resolves to the view PlaceDef TypeDescriptorBinding; its RCTS semantic_type.arguments[0] equals the owner PlaceDef.type_id
access through view_place_id identifies this LoanId and does not conflict with its own loan; every other overlapping access follows the ordinary conflict matrix
Borrow and inout descriptors projected as ViewRelease require exactly one matching LoanDef with view_release_required=true
BeginLoan makes the declared view place Live; matching EndLoan makes it Uninitialized and discharges ViewRelease exactly once without creating a CleanupTokenId
a callable borrow/inout parameter loan has both call_instance_id_or_null and argument_ordinal_or_null non-null; a non-call lexical loan has both null
a view access is admitted only when AccessFact.via_loan_id_or_null names this exact LoanDef and its queried LoanState is Active; Suspended, Ended or absent loan state authorizes zero view access

view_alias_bindings form a total bijection from the declared view subtree to the corresponding owner subtree by identical relative projection key; normalization follows the acyclic parent-loan/view-alias chain transitively to one ultimate non-view owner PlaceId before overlap, coverage, isolation-source or reservation checks

fields.view_place_id: PlaceId in the LoanDef view subtree
fields.owner_place_id: PlaceId in the LoanDef owner subtree
fields.relative_projection_key: canonical relative projection sequence; empty for the root pair

ViewAliasBinding.law: within each LoanDef the view and owner PlaceIds are each unique and form one bijection with equal relative projection keys; a ViewRelease PlaceId belongs to exactly one LoanDef, while one owner PlaceId may be the target of multiple distinct Shared LoanDefs whose coexistence is decided by the loan conflict rules. Mapped semantic types agree after stripping exactly one borrow/inout view descriptor.

laws: every edge endpoint and access point resolves in point_ids
predecessor_state_ids are exactly the reachable incoming snapshots for current_point_id
operation order is (CfgPointId canonical order, AccessFact.sequence_ordinal)

at the selected operation point, AccessFact rows are a bijection with the exact role/place/mode/via-loan rows derived from operation_loan_access_matrix; prior-point rows remain typed history, while an extra, missing, duplicate or stale current-point row is INPUT_INVALID

AccessFact.law: access through a borrow/inout view names its exact Active LoanId; ordinary direct owner-place access uses null. The sole privileged owner-place exception is the ReplaceInout caller MutAcquire role, whose via_loan_id_or_null equals the exact Active Exclusive call LoanId and whose call_instance/argument fields match both operation and LoanDef. The selected operation's current-point AccessFacts are derived only from operation_loan_access_matrix, and their sequence_ordinal is canonical role order.

Operation.law: every field is required for its selected kind and fields from other variants are forbidden

InitializationBinding.law: Initialize.ownership_unit_bindings is canonical-sorted and contains exactly one row for every ownership unit in the selected initialization closure; non-ownership-unit places have no row

fields.decision_point_id: CfgPointId equal to Operation.at_point_id, ReplaceInout.acquire_point_id or Join.target_point_id

EscapeContext.law: decision_point_id always equals cfg.current_point_id and binds this context to exactly the selected operation decision. Join uses NotApplicable with boundary None and all region/proof fields empty while retaining Join.target_point_id as decision_point_id. Every other operation uses Applicable and independently recomputes source_region_id_or_null from typed input facts: ordinary selected places normalize transitively through ViewAlias, loan operations use the exact owner, parent or ended LoanDef rule, Move uses the current OwnerId holder, with an exact selected/normalized PlaceDef storage-region fallback only for a local Moved or MaybeMoved rejection that has no holder; this fallback never restores authority, routes Moved to USE_AFTER_MOVE and MaybeMoved to PLACE_STATE_JOIN_MISMATCH, and treats Live ownerless, Uninitialized or reference mismatch as INPUT_INVALID. ReplaceInout uses the replacement current OwnerId holder. BeginSharedLoan and BeginExclusiveLoan are resolved before the ordinary existing-view path: source is Operation.loan_id -> exact LoanDef.owner_place_id -> ultimate non-view PlaceDef.storage_region_id; boundary None has null target/origin; Return, Capture and Suspension use LoanRegion{loan_id=Operation.loan_id} and exact LoanDef.region_id after exact operation start/owner/view/kind/region and view-storage-region binding; every other Begin boundary is INPUT_INVALID. A valid Begin context remains separate from BorrowEscape admission, so Exclusive Suspension can be context-valid and semantically rejected. Ordinary existing-view Return uses the nearest Invocation RegionAncestor from its exact active via-loan source; ordinary Capture/Suspension uses one exact current-point active LoanRegion. Actual-boundary Move uses Operation.destination_place_id PlaceStorage and Store is not admitted in R5. Boundary None otherwise requires both target_region_id_or_null and target_region_origin_or_null null. The validator derives expected source, origin and target without using their serialized values as an oracle and requires exact equality. Every unlisted combination is INPUT_INVALID.

IsolationContext.law: Join uses NotApplicable with both domains null, transfer None and no proof. Applicable contexts bind source_domain_id_or_null to the actual source RegionDef and destination_domain_id_or_null to the actual destination RegionDef when a destination exists; operation-specific transfer/proof rules are closed by isolation_context_matrix and extra, stale, missing or mismatched proof is INPUT_INVALID.

laws: plan and token identities are unique
acquisition_order contains each declared token exactly once

fields.action_keys: ordered nonempty array<canonical cleanup action key>

PlaceDef.value_class and cleanup_requirement equal the deterministic projection of its descriptor_v5 ownership and cleanup axes; mutability equals the canonical binding/operation fact identified by mutability_origin
every OwnershipState contains exactly one PlaceState for every declared PlaceId

every OwnerDef resolves one immutable origin PlaceId, origin RegionId and optional CleanupPlanId; its derived queried binding is Unissued, one Live ownership-unit holder, one state-level conditional predecessor-alternative group, or Retired, and current region exists only for the Live-holder case
every RegionDef resolves one IsolationDomainId; every PlaceDef storage_region_id resolves one RegionDef

every LoanDef resolves distinct owner/view PlaceIds, one view TypeDescriptorBinding, one RegionId and a total projection-preserving ViewAliasBinding bijection; an optional parent loan resolves once and forms an acyclic tree, and every LoanState status exactly agrees with its complete view subtree plus the R5 one-active-child parent/child law

every CleanupTokenDef resolves one CleanupPlan and one Owner and has exactly one state row in every reachable OwnershipState; CleanupTokenDef.owner_id equals CleanupPlan.owner_id, that OwnerDef.cleanup_plan_id_or_null equals the same plan, Available holder is that Owner while Unbound and Consumed have null holder

RCTS cleanup totality is exact: Reusable/None and Reusable/ViewRelease have zero owner plan/token; Affine/None OwnerDef has null cleanup plan and zero token; Resource/DropExactlyOnce OwnerDef has one nonnull plan and exactly one predeclared token epoch

within one OwnershipState an OwnerId occurs at exactly one Live ownership-unit PlaceState or only inside one state-level JoinConflict predecessor alternative set, never both; projections never repeat OwnerId and resolve through ownership_unit_move_path_id_or_null

an Available cleanup token is referenced by exactly one Live ownership-unit place or only inside the same state-level JoinConflict predecessor alternative set, never both; Unbound/Consumed tokens have no place reference and projections never duplicate token references

every MaybeMoved PlaceState references the one JoinConflictId in its state whose covered_places contains that PlaceId; one join never duplicates predecessor owner/token alternatives across per-place conflict objects

each non-null PlaceState reservation_id_or_null resolves to one Active MoveReservationState for that exact Live ownership-unit place and every Active reservation is referenced by exactly one such place; Moved, Uninitialized, MaybeMoved and non-ownership-unit places carry no reservation

entry_state_id always resolves; query_state_id_or_null resolves exactly once for non-Join and is null for Join; operation_prefix_point_ids is exactly the reachable-from-entry and can-reach-current intersection, includes current for non-Join, excludes the not-yet-produced Join target, and is in bijection with OwnershipState.point_id
cfg.predecessor_state_ids equals the complete canonical-sorted reachable incoming state set for current_point_id
the selected Operation references only declared IDs and its point is cfg.current_point_id except ReplaceInout and Join, whose closed fields state their exact points

a Move source_destination_disjoint_proof_id_or_null is the sole operation-bound overlap-proof reference: when non-null it resolves exactly one recomputed PlaceOverlapProof whose ordered left_root/right_root PlaceId subjects are root_representative(source_place_id) and root_representative(destination_place_id), whose proof kind is admitted for those roots/projections, and whose exact [at_point_id] scope plus derivation digest establish DISJOINT; no IsolationContext proof substitutes for it

every selected Operation resolves the exact unique current-point AccessFact role set prescribed by operation_loan_access_matrix; CancelReservation, EndLoan and Join resolve zero current-point facts, Move resolves source Move plus destination Write, ReplaceInout resolves caller MutAcquire plus replacement Move plus staging Write, and an extra/missing/stale role is INPUT_INVALID

every BeginSharedLoan, BeginExclusiveLoan, BeginReborrow and EndLoan operation exactly matches the referenced LoanDef kind, owner/view places, region, parent identity and start/end point before any state transition; BeginReborrow child_owner_place_id is in the exact Active parent LoanDef view subtree and normalizes through that parent alias before reaching the ultimate non-view owner

BeginSharedLoan and BeginExclusiveLoan require a null parent_loan_id and an owner place outside every ViewAlias view subtree; borrowing through a view is admitted only by BeginReborrow with the exact Active parent LoanId

EscapeContext.decision_point_id equals cfg.current_point_id and the selected Operation at/target/acquire decision point; applicability plus source/target regions and IsolationContext domains are recomputed from the selected operation's actual source and destination PlaceDefs, Owner binding and RegionDefs; serialized context copied from another point is INPUT_INVALID

Initialize on a ViewRelease place is always REJECT; only BeginSharedLoan, BeginExclusiveLoan or BeginReborrow may make such a view Live
escape and isolation proofs resolve to ClosedProof rows whose kind, subjects and CFG scope exactly cover the requested boundary
expected outcomes, diagnostics, fixture names and filenames are absent from OwnershipDecisionInputR1

rcts_place_projection.identity_law: TypeDescriptorBinding.type_id equals descriptor_v5.semantic_type.type_id after canonical normalization

cleanup_owner_totality.Reusable:ViewRelease: zero OwnerDef, zero CleanupPlan and zero CleanupTokenDef; discharge belongs only to the matching LoanDef

Active and Suspended loans both reserve/conflict their normalized owner subtree; Suspended removes only direct view authorization. An access through the Active leaf is exempt from that leaf and its exact Suspended ancestor chain, but every unrelated access is checked against both statuses. overlap.variant_payloads: DISJOINT only with point-bound ActiveVariantExclusion proof
overlap.fresh_affine_roots: DISJOINT only with closed FreshAffineRoots proof

move_path_propagation.unaffected_sibling_access: admitted only when the sibling MovePath is Live and overlap analysis proves it disjoint from every active conflicting access
move_path_propagation.child_reinitialization: Initialize may restore a Moved child subtree to Live only through its exact Mutable child PlaceId with no owner/loan/token/reservation; the complete initialization closure and exact ownership_unit_bindings are committed in canonical descendant-before-root order, then whole-value capability is recomputed
move_path_propagation.ownership_unit: each independently movable Affine or Resource MovePath is an ownership unit; its root PlaceState is the sole state-local OwnerId/token holder and projections name the nearest unit while keeping owner/token fields null
move_path_propagation.state_rewrite_closure: the selected MovePath PlaceId plus every required descendant PlaceId, including non-ownership-unit projections, in canonical normalized projection order
move_path_propagation.ownership_transfer_units: exactly the PlaceIds in state_rewrite_closure whose MovePathDef.is_ownership_unit is true, in canonical MovePathId order
move_path_propagation.whole_move_state_rewrite_set: root plus every required descendant PlaceId
move_path_propagation.partial_move_state_rewrite_set: the selected direct Field/Tuple child plus every required descendant PlaceId; ancestors and disjoint siblings remain unchanged
move_path_propagation.destination_shape: source and destination roots have equal normalized TypeId; map the empty relative suffix from selected source root to selected destination root, then require a bijection of every required descendant MovePath by its normalized projection suffix relative to those selected roots and exact TypeId
move_path_propagation.atomic_rewrite: every source PlaceState in state_rewrite_closure becomes Moved and every corresponding destination PlaceState becomes Live; only ownership_transfer_units carry the bijectively transferred OwnerIds and owner-bound tokens, all other rows keep owner/token null; an omitted descendant, duplicate or stranded owner/token rejects before commit

loan_access_conflict_matrix.normalization: transitively normalize every access and loan owner/view through ViewAliasBinding to the ultimate non-view owner before overlap
loan_access_conflict_matrix.ancestor_chain_exemption: an access through the exact Active leaf ignores conflict only from that leaf and its exact Suspended ancestors; every unrelated Active or Suspended loan is still evaluated
loan_access_conflict_matrix.ended_or_absent: no conflict authority and no view-access authority

operation_loan_access_matrix.rule: ordinary initialization is a mutation of the complete selected subtree and rejects every overlapping Active or Suspended loan before commit; its own Uninitialized/Moved admission rule remains independently required

access_roles.via_loan: exact AccessFact.via_loan_id_or_null; null for owner access or exact Active leaf for view access

operation_loan_access_matrix.rule: ordinary owner access has no exemption; a view access receives only the exact Active leaf plus Suspended-ancestor exemption

access_roles.via_loan: exact AccessFact.via_loan_id_or_null; null for owner access or exact Active Exclusive leaf for view access

operation_loan_access_matrix.rule: ordinary owner mutation has no exemption; a view mutation requires the exact Active Exclusive leaf plus Suspended-ancestor exemption
reservation performs the same complete normalized loan-conflict check as its future move and creates no loan exemption
cancellation changes only the exact reservation row and does not access the reserved value
the current inout value is not movable through a loan; both source and destination normalized subtrees reject every conflicting Active or Suspended loan before commit
root borrowing is checked against every existing normalized Active or Suspended loan and may not borrow through a view
root borrowing is checked against every existing normalized Active or Suspended loan and may not borrow through a view

access_roles.via_loan: Operation.parent_loan_id naming the exact Active parent leaf

ending a loan changes only its loan state and mapped ViewRelease subtree; it performs no owner-value access

operation_loan_access_matrix.rule: the call loan authorizes only the caller MutAcquire role as the sole direct-owner via-loan exception, with exact call_instance_id and argument_ordinal equality; every unrelated overlapping loan and all replacement/staging conflicts are checked before commit

access_roles.place_binding: every PlaceId in the computed full owned-descendant state_rewrite_closure rooted at Operation.place_id

operation_loan_access_matrix.rule: one current-point AccessFact is required for every unique place in the complete owned closure; cleanup rejects every overlapping Active or Suspended loan before the first token is consumed
join compares complete predecessor loan states and rejects divergence or covered live loans; it performs no direct value access

escape_context_matrix.source_region: selected PlaceDef after transitive ViewAlias normalization -> storage_region_id
escape_context_matrix.boundary: actual operation-bound escape boundary or None
escape_context_matrix.target_region: actual target storage/lifetime RegionId when boundary requires one, otherwise null

escape_context_matrix.proof_rule: boundary None requires empty; otherwise require the exact closed boundary proof set

transition_rules.rule: ViewRelease places reject ordinary Initialize. For an ordinary selected place, derive the complete required descendant state_rewrite_closure and require every row Uninitialized, or allow a Moved mutable child subtree only under the exact child-reinitialization law; no row may have an owner, available token or reservation, and the complete normalized subtree must have no overlapping Active or Suspended loan under the Write access-mode row. ownership_unit_bindings contains exactly one canonical row for every ownership unit in that closure. Reusable rows have no binding; each Affine/None unit names one predeclared OwnerId never held in any typed reachable-prefix state and null token; each Resource/DropExactlyOnce unit names one such OwnerId plus its exact Unbound CleanupTokenId. TokenDef.owner, TokenDef.plan, CleanupPlan.owner and OwnerDef.cleanup_plan are identical, and OwnerDef origin place/region match the unit. Commit descendants before their ownership-unit roots, then publish the whole closure atomically. Retired OwnerIds and Consumed tokens are never reused; no allocator, source order or hidden identity synthesis is consulted.

Require Live place and Live required child move paths with no overlapping Active or Suspended Exclusive loan, except the exact Active leaf plus Suspended ancestor chain authorizing this via-loan access; state is unchanged.

Ordinary Write is nonownership mutation and requires whole_value_readable(place_id), a Mutable place, no overlapping Active or Suspended loan except the exact Active Exclusive leaf plus Suspended ancestor chain authorizing this via-loan access, and the same admitted isolation domain; state is unchanged. Whole overwrite or replacement is expressed only by Initialize or ReplaceInout.

Require whole_value_movable(place_id, null) for a Live ownership-unit place with no Active or Suspended overlapping loan, then accept the exact never-issued ReservationId supplied by the operation, create one Active MoveReservationState for that place, and write that identity to reservation_id_or_null. Read remains admitted; every overlapping Write, borrow, cleanup, replacement, other reservation or other Move rejects until exact Move or CancelReservation consumes the reservation.
Only the exact Active ReservationId supplied by the operation may be cancelled; mark that reservation Cancelled and clear the matching place reservation_id_or_null without moving owner or token.

Require a Live Affine/Resource source with whole_value_movable(source, reservation_id_or_null), a wholly Uninitialized destination state_rewrite_closure with zero Active reservations, exact normalized source/destination TypeId and MovePath-shape equality, a live destination region at commit, and a DISJOINT source/destination result under the conservative overlap rule. source_destination_disjoint_proof_id_or_null is non-null exactly when that result depends on a proof: it resolves one recomputed PlaceOverlapProof whose ordered left_root/right_root PlaceId subjects are root_representative(source_place_id) and root_representative(destination_place_id), whose scope_points is exactly [at_point_id], whose proof kind is admitted for those roots/projections, and whose derivation digest is exact; IsolationContext proof_ids never substitute for this operation-bound overlap proof. If reservation_id_or_null is present it must name the exact Active reservation on source and is the sole reservation excluded from the conflict set; if absent source must have no reservation. Across isolation domains, IsolationContext must equal the actual source/destination RegionDef domains, transfer is exactly Move, and every ownership_transfer_unit has one exact recomputed TypeId/OwnerId/destination-domain Transferable proof with no extra or missing proof. Atomically mark every source state_rewrite_closure row Moved and every corresponding destination row Live, while bijectively transferring OwnerIds and owner-bound CleanupTokenIds only for ownership_transfer_units; consume the matching reservation when present. Cleanup-free units transfer zero tokens. A partial move is admitted only for one direct static Field/Tuple ownership unit of a direct-local cleanup-free Affine aggregate. Resource, Reusable, non-owning view, dynamic-index, deref, shared, actor, FFI and inout-current-value partial moves reject. No implicit conversion is admitted. Any precommit failure preserves both subtrees and reservation.

Require the operation fields to equal one declared root Shared LoanDef with parent_loan_id_or_null null at its exact start point; owner_place_id is readable and is outside every ViewAlias view subtree. Require an Uninitialized distinct borrow/ViewRelease view subtree, a total projection-preserving view_alias_bindings map, a contained RegionId and admitted boundary; add one Active Shared loan and make the complete view subtree Live. Access through that view supplies via_loan_id_or_null equal to this Active loan, normalizes through the alias map before overlap, and does not conflict with itself.

Require the operation fields to equal one declared root Exclusive LoanDef with parent_loan_id_or_null null at its exact start point; owner_place_id is writable and is outside every ViewAlias view subtree. Require an Uninitialized distinct inout/ViewRelease view subtree, a total projection-preserving view_alias_bindings map, no overlapping Active or Suspended loan, a contained RegionId and admitted boundary; add one Active Exclusive loan and make the complete view subtree Live. Access through that view supplies via_loan_id_or_null equal to this Active loan, normalizes through the alias map before overlap, and does not conflict with itself.

Require the operation fields to exactly match the child LoanDef and its Active parent. child_owner_place_id is the parent LoanDef view root or an exact mapped subplace in that view subtree, never the ultimate direct owner; its AccessFact names the parent LoanId and normalization follows child view -> parent view -> ultimate non-view owner. Require an Uninitialized distinct child view subtree with total projection-preserving alias map and a contained child region at the exact child start point. Shared parent permits Shared only; Exclusive permits Shared or Exclusive. Suspend parent, make the complete child view subtree Live and activate the child loan.

Require operation loan_id and at_point_id to equal one declared end point of an Active LoanDef. End only when it has no active child; make every mapped view subtree PlaceState Uninitialized, discharge ViewRelease exactly once, and resume its parent only after the final child ends.

Require one exact Active Exclusive call LoanDef whose owner_place_id is the caller place, whose call_instance_id/argument_ordinal equal the operation, whose inout ViewRelease subtree is Live, and whose active child-loan count is zero. Caller, already-materialized Live replacement_place_id and old_value_staging_place_id have exact normalized TypeId and required MovePath-shape equality; the staging subtree is wholly Uninitialized, transaction-local, inaccessible and in the same Invocation region. acquire_point_id is cfg.current_point_id, strictly dominates commit_point_id through the declared normal CFG path, and every typed/shape/overlap/loan/reservation/isolation check completes before commit. IsolationContext binds actual RHS/caller domains, requires equality, transfer Move and no proof. Precommit rejection leaves caller, staging and RHS byte-identical; the existing RHS holder retains its ordinary cleanup responsibility and this operation performs no hidden acquisition or cleanup. Commit is one non-rollback transaction: atomically move the complete old caller subtree with all OwnerIds/tokens into staging, publish the complete RHS subtree at the fixed caller PlaceIds, and mark RHS Moved. Then irrevocably consume old staging tokens in reverse acquisition order and execute all old cleanup actions exactly once. After all cleanup attempts, always make the complete staging subtree Uninitialized and retire every old owner. If the aggregate failure is nonempty, keep the new caller value published, preserve canonical primary/suppressed failure order, and propagate only after final staging retirement; rollback and repeated cleanup are forbidden. The call loan remains Active and authorizes the same caller/view alias map until EndLoan.

ViewRelease is never handled by Cleanup. For a Live Resource ownership-unit root, derive its full owned-descendant state_rewrite_closure and exact Available token set; require no Active or Suspended overlapping loan or Active reservation and require cleanup_token_ids to equal those tokens in reverse CleanupContext.acquisition_order. Irrevocably consume each token before invoking its owner-bound plan, execute every plan action exactly once, continue after a cleanup failure under the existing deterministic primary/suppressed law, then make the root and every owned cleanup-free or cleanup-bearing descendant Uninitialized, remove every OwnerId, and leave every token Consumed with null holder. Failure never rolls back state or permits double cleanup.

First require byte-identical global LoanState, CleanupTokenState, MoveReservationState and prior JoinConflict sets across all reachable predecessors; divergence rejects PLACE_STATE_JOIN_MISMATCH at the join and constructs no output. Compare every per-PlaceId tuple before constructing output. If all are exact, copy places and any one identical prior JoinConflict row. If a prior JoinConflict row exists and any tuple differs, reject at the join because R5 admits neither nesting nor flattening. Otherwise compute every declared PlaceId whose ViewAlias-normalized owner place overlaps a mismatch. If that coverage intersects any Active/Suspended loan owner or view subtree, or any Active reservation place, reject at the join to preserve loan/view/reservation coherence. Otherwise require the operation's exact fresh new_join_conflict_id_or_null, create exactly one state-level JoinConflict containing every mismatch and covered place, make every covered output row MaybeMoved with null owner/token/reservation, and point every covered row to that ID. A proven-disjoint sibling is not covered. A first ownership-sensitive use or required cleanup rejects PLACE_STATE_JOIN_MISMATCH. No widening or order winner is admitted.
